notes.title: Update #5: Let me tell you...
notes.content:
Hello, I've made another update for you. Already running out of ideas...



[b]List of changes:[/b]
[list]
[*] Some dancing guys in the Hangar may tell you a story or a joke. Just go to them :)
[*] The guys in the hangar moved a little (flying in the air)
[*] Fixed some hitboxes
[/list]


[u]If you have read this, thank you very much.[/u]
I also look forward to your feedback and suggestions. Have a good game.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43945002/189b4172f3e03e0784f092448a02391441fd449e.gif[/img]

notes.title: Update #4: Telekinesis?

notes.title: Mini update #2: Oh, what do we have here
notes.content:
And I brought food here, hold on.

[/list]

notes.title: Update #2: It's time to dress up or undress...

tags.balance_change: [*] The T-34 tank is now trying to go on the attack a little more;
[*] One of the Nazi trucks is also rolling now;

tags.feature: [*] A Nazi hat has appeared on the map, which you can pick up and put on your head :)

tags.bug: [*] In one place, in the explosion, your girl loses her bra and exposes her charms;

notes.title: Update #1: IT WORKS!!!

tags.bug: [*] Fixed bug with radio when one radio was destroyed, all others were destroyed as well. Now you need to destroy all the radio yourself;

[*] Fixed a bug with the end of the game button, when it did not appear or when the player blew up the equipment, the game ended, now you can completely end the game only by pressing the button near the Boss;

tags.feature: [*] Added the corpse of the pilot of the falling aircraft;

notes.title: Mini Update #1: Fixim FIXIM
notes.content:
And finally, our game is available to you.

But I noticed mistakes, I became completely blind :С
